{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored blazer with wide lapels, relaxed fit, knee-length cut, camel color #D2B48C, lightweight wool blend.
Silk-blend blouse with a subtle sheen, classic collar, hip-length hem, cream color #F5F5DC, fluid satin weave.
High-waisted tapered trousers, straight leg, ankle length, charcoal gray color #36454F, soft stretch twill.
Leather loafers, square toe, mid-calf height, dark brown color #4B2E1C, smooth full-grain leather.

This outfit perfectly balances the relaxed atmosphere of a casual restaurant date with a touch of sophistication suitable for the autumn season. The camel and cream tones create a warm, inviting palette that feels effortless yet polished for daylight hours at one o'clock. The tailored blazer adds structure without feeling stiff, while the trousers provide comfort for an evening out that doesn't require formal attire."}
